entry.title: Building my own PDP-11/70 anyway
entry.summary: SIMH exists, it is excellent, and I did not use it. This is the second half of the story: the engineering compromises, the debugging, the architectural debts — and why the machine room was worth building twice.

entry.title: Bringing back the machine room: rebuilding a PDP-11/70 I first met in 1984
entry.summary: I grew up with Soviet PDP-11 clones. Thirty years later I built a PDP-11/70 emulator in the browser to get that machine room feeling back — and this is what it cost.
